issues.cause: The current cards_list HTTP 404 failure can bypass the post-hook and expose its bank response only inside cards_list_response.message as a Python dictionary representation. current_list_warning accepts JSON text only, so the documented no-card warning incorrectly becomes a technical failure.
issues.repair: Add bounded, non-executing parsing of JSON and Python literal representations. Recognize the no-card outcome only with the existing current-request, fresh-counter and HTTP 404 guards plus explicit matching returnCode, code and WARNING type.
issues.validation: Statically reviewed result consumption, error normalization and the final main-menu route. No tools or tests were run. Existing checks, smoke and scenarios are unchanged; regressions are appended.
